title: My kite
text:
My kite is red and green and blue,
it has a long tail, yellow too.
I hold the string and run, run, run
across the field beneath the sun.

The wind picks up. My kite flies high!
It dips and dances in the sky.
It swoops and twirls, then climbs up higher,
just like a bird that will not tire.

When evening comes, the wind is slow,
and down, down, down my kite will go.
I wind it in and hold it tight.
Tomorrow we will fly. Goodnight!
